title: Finance expert calls for first-time buyer support reform
summary:
Financial data group Moneyfacts has called for reforms to support first-time buyers ahead of the Autumn Budget, highlighting concerns that existing schemes have failed to keep pace with rising property prices. Rachel Springall, Finance Expert at Moneyfacts, said the house purchase cap on Lifetime ISAs has remained static since 2017 despite significant property price increases.

The post Finance expert calls for first-time buyer support reform appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Foreign-sounding names face mortgage scrutiny, law firm claims
summary:
British citizens and residents with foreign-sounding names are encountering additional scrutiny and delays when attempting to purchase property in the UK, according to a property law firm. Tatiana Sharposhnikova, Chief Executive of Sharpwell Property Law, has stated that discrimination exists in the British property market.

The post Foreign-sounding names face mortgage scrutiny, law firm claims appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Martin & Co franchisee acquires third agency in 12 months
summary:
A Martin & Co franchisee has completed the acquisition of a third lettings agency within a 12-month period, marking continued consolidation within the Worcestershire lettings market. Nirvair Sander, who operates the Martin & Co Worcester franchise, has purchased Parsons Choice, a lettings agency based in Stoke Prior.

The post Martin & Co franchisee acquires third agency in 12 months appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Specialist lender backs probate property deal with £458k
summary:
Avamore Capital has provided £458,000 in development finance for the acquisition and refurbishment of a probate property with unregistered land, arranged through broker Aureum Finance. The transaction involved multiple complexities, including the purchase of an unregistered probate asset, which required coordination between legal teams and the lender to meet regulatory requirements.

title: Hotel operator secures £95m South West refinancing
summary:
FRP Real Estate Advisory has arranged a £95 million facilities package for a privately owned hotel group operating three properties in the South West of England. The financing includes a £75 million bilateral loan and £10 million accordion facility from a high street bank.

The post Hotel operator secures £95m South West refinancing appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Title insurance enables 11-day £1.2m bridging deal
summary:
Precise has completed a £1.2m bridging finance transaction in 11 working days, using title insurance and joint representation legal structures to accelerate a time-sensitive refinance for a development project. The deal progressed from application to offer in seven working days, with a four-day period from offer to completion.

title: Conveyancing platform launches with direct buyer-seller messaging
summary:
A new conveyancing platform has launched in the UK, offering real-time visibility of property chains to all parties involved in transactions. CentreMove allows buyers and sellers to conduct searches themselves and enables direct communication before offers are made.

The post Conveyancing platform launches with direct buyer-seller messaging appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: London agency adopts compliance tech amid rising fines
summary:
A London estate agency has implemented technology to manage increasing rental sector compliance requirements, as non-compliance penalties reach up to £40,000 per offence since May. Brinkleys has integrated an API system to identify high-risk properties before they incur fines.

The post London agency adopts compliance tech amid rising fines appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Build-to-rent starts plunge 84% outside London
summary:
New build-to-rent housing starts in UK regions outside London have fallen by 84% in the year to June 2026, according to data from Savills. Nationally, the number of new build-to-rent homes decreased by 79% over the same period.

title: Two-thirds of Foxtons rental applicants from overseas
summary:
Nearly two-thirds of rental property applicants at London agency Foxtons originate from overseas, according to internal data released by the company. The figures highlight challenges facing letting agents processing applications from tenants without UK-based financial references.
